name: OpenClaw Localtrace
description: Full-fidelity OpenTelemetry capture written only to your local filesystem -- no redaction, no network export, no third-party backend.

enabled.description: Master on/off switch. Off by default -- this plugin only ever does something once explicitly enabled.

outputDir.description: Local directory to write OTLP JSON batch files into. Defaults to a subdirectory of this plugin's own OpenClaw-managed state directory when omitted.

captureContent.description: Include raw prompt/response/tool-argument/tool-result content on spans. Off by default -- see README before enabling.

captureIdentifiers.description: Include sessionId/runId/callId on spans and metrics. Off by default even though this is the plugin's whole purpose -- a local file with real session identifiers is still real data at rest. See README before enabling.

maxOutputBytes.description: Retention ceiling in bytes for the output directory (default 500 MiB). Oldest files are deleted first once exceeded.

maxAgeDays.description: Delete output files older than this many days, checked on a periodic sweep.

mutatingToolNames.description: Tool names classified as a write/mutation for the openclaw.mutatingAction span attribute. Overrides the built-in default list (exec, apply_patch, write_file, edit_file, delete_file) -- extend or replace this for custom tools with side effects your deployment adds. See README.
